slides.title: Caterers: when the venue asks for your COI the week of the holiday party, here's exactly what to say:

slides.label: Say this
slides.title: "Absolutely. I'll send the current one over today."
slides.body: Calm. Friendly. Like it's already in a folder.

slides.label: Then do this
slides.title: Open it and read the dates before you hit send.
slides.body: Venues notice when the certificate says it ended in September.

slides.label: If it lapsed
slides.title: "Our renewal is in process. I'll send the updated certificate as soon as it's issued."
slides.body: Then call your agent. Today, not after the party.

slides.label: While you're in there
slides.title: Check the food handler cards, the health permit and the van registration too.
slides.body: December is when everything gets asked for at once.

slides.label: Save this
slides.title: For the next venue email that says "quick favor."
slides.body: What's the worst last-minute paperwork ask you've gotten?
